messages:
celine: tiny idea for today  '5-word holiday micro-poems' + matching gif. drop a 5-word line and a gif (or emoji) for quick cheer. winner = most :sparkles: reacts by 4pm. low effort. :evergreen_tree:

omar: love this. i'll start: 'snow on keyboard, coffee in hand' :snowflake: :coffee:

ryan: nice. mine: 'leftover pie, warm socks, bright lights' :pie: :socks: :bulb:

sara: ok here's mine: 'tiny lights, louder laughs, slow time' :star2:

gif-bot: GIF added: https://giphy.com/gifs/holiday-cheer-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA

omar: tagging @here  drop yours even if it's silly. 5 words only! :grin:

celine: love the vibe. i'll tally reactions at 4pm and post a tiny winner badge. also adding a 'bonus' category: best gif pairing. :trophy:

ryan: voted for omar's line. also submitting a backup: 'mistletoe sweater, awkward but warm' :sweater:

sara: voting now. can we do this monthly? micro-cheer is great. :thumbsup:

gif-bot: Reminder: Voting ends at 16:00 today (channel: #random).

celine: thanks all! will announce around 16:05. take a sec to react if you like something. tiny joys for a busy week. :sparkles:
